_doc: Emerald's post-game slot edits (data/hoenn_postgame_encounters.json has the rules): the species Emerald lacks (Surskit/Masquerain, Meditite/Medicham, Roselia, Zangoose, Lunatone) in their Sapphire/Ruby slots, without taking anything Emerald needs (a Seviper slot and grass slot 11 on Route 114, Emerald's only wild Nuzleaf, stay; Seedot keeps two routes). Replaces the whole 'maps'.

Route102.note: surf 4 (1 %) Goldeen -> Surskit (Goldeen is fished here)

Route114.note: grass 5 (10 %) Lombre -> Zangoose (Lombre keeps 6, 7; Seviper keeps 8-10, 9 %; slot 11 Nuzleaf untouched); surf 4 (1 %) Goldeen -> Surskit

Route117.note: grass 1, 3 (30 %) Oddish -> Roselia (Oddish keeps 5, 10 %, and its other routes); surf 4 (1 %) Goldeen -> Surskit

Route120.note: grass 11 (1 %) Seedot -> Surskit (Seedot keeps Routes 102 and 117, 1 % each, and the Rustboro trade); surf 4 (1 %) Goldeen -> Surskit

MtPyre_Exterior.note: grass 1, 3 (30 %) Shuppet -> Meditite (Shuppet keeps 0, 2, 30 %, and Mt. Pyre 1F-6F)

VictoryRoad_B1F.note: grass 3 (10 %) Lairon -> Medicham (Lairon keeps 2, 8, 10; Mawile 9, 11 untouched)

VictoryRoad_B2F.note: grass 3 (10 %) Lairon -> Medicham (Lairon keeps 2, 8, 10; Mawile 9, 11 untouched)

MeteorFalls_1F_1R.note: grass Solrock 5 (10 %) / Lunatone 6, 7 (10 %); surf Solrock 2 (5 %) / Lunatone 3, 4 (5 %) (Steven's Cave keeps its Solrock)

MeteorFalls_1F_2R.note: grass Solrock 3, 5 (20 %) / Lunatone 4, 7 (15 %); surf Solrock 2 (5 %) / Lunatone 3, 4 (5 %) (Steven's Cave keeps its Solrock)

MeteorFalls_B1F_1R.note: grass Solrock 3, 5 (20 %) / Lunatone 4, 7 (15 %); surf Solrock 2 (5 %) / Lunatone 3, 4 (5 %) (Steven's Cave keeps its Solrock)

MeteorFalls_B1F_2R.note: grass Solrock 3, 7 (15 %) / Lunatone 5 (10 %); surf Solrock 2 (5 %) / Lunatone 3, 4 (5 %) (Steven's Cave keeps its Solrock)
